expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第2–4天转矩约30%缺失；第3–6天伸出时间约20%重复。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 2–4: about 30% of torque rows missing; days 3–6: about 20% of extension rows duplicated.

expected_health_response.zh: 报告缺失与重复；不得误报；数据不足处可 UNKNOWN。
expected_health_response.en: Report missing and duplicate data; no false alarms; UNKNOWN where data is insufficient.

abstention_cases.zh: 缺失过多的窗口应弃权（DATA_QUALITY）。
abstention_cases.en: Windows with too many missing rows should abstain (DATA_QUALITY).
